description: Non-material amendment to approved permission 1759/23 (as amended by Non-Material Amendment 1759/23/07) : Alteration to party wall depths to comply with Building Regulations Part L, with resulting extension to the footprint of the building to the rear by 777.5mm. Alteration to depth of service risers and smoke ducts to achieve minimum 850mm required within Building Regulations Part B for natural smoke shafts. Adjustments to layouts of homes to comply with nationally described space standards, Building Regulations Part M, and design guidance. Door, window, and building line positions amended to align with unit layouts. A window omitted to two kitchens where these clashed with kitchen counters and cupboards. Brick piers added to rear south corner balcony. Introduction of a substation at ground floor level to meet the requirements of UKPN and window omitted at ground floor. (Summary).
